description: Score a document collection against a user-defined dictionary and project it onto a science backbone.

schedulerOptions.name: TACC Scheduler Profile
schedulerOptions.description: Scheduler profile for HPC clusters at TACC

schedulerOptions.name: TAP Session Substring
schedulerOptions.description: TAP Functions require the substring 'tap_' and in the slurm job name in order to function.

envVariables.description: Workflow run by the shared image.

How terms are counted. auto: reproduces the original notebook. longest_match: overlapping terms such as 'land subsidence' and 'subsidence' count once. word_boundary: whole words only, overlaps still count.
How dictionary groups map onto the backbone. legacy: original notebook. subdiscipline_aware: splits each domain across subdisciplines using their names instead of file order.
Groups that match no backbone domain. drop: original notebook (their matches get weight 0). keep: their matches are reported under Uncategorized.
JSON list of file name patterns to include, e.g. ["*Brown_Bag*"].
Maximum number of files to read from the corpus folder.
Skip files with fewer characters of text than this.
Also write one backbone figure per document.

fileInputs.name: Corpus
fileInputs.description: Folder of documents to analyze: .txt, .md, .json transcripts, .docx, or .pdf (text layer).

fileInputs.name: Dictionary (JSON)
fileInputs.description: Optional. Keyword groups as {"Group": ["term", ...]} or the structured lexicon format. Omit to use the built-in SUBSIDE dictionary.

fileInputs.name: Dictionary (CSV)
fileInputs.description: Optional alternative to the JSON dictionary: a CSV with group and term columns.

fileInputs.name: Science backbone (JSON)
fileInputs.description: Optional. A science_backbone.json or structured taxonomy file. Omit to use the built-in SUBSIDE backbone.

fileInputs.name: Job configuration (YAML)
fileInputs.description: Optional. Full settings file; see configs/dictionary-example.yaml in the repository.

notes.label: Semantic Sensemaking: dictionary overlay
notes.helpText: Counts where each group of a user-defined dictionary appears in a folder of documents, maps the groups onto a science backbone, and writes CSV tables, interactive HTML figures, a Markdown summary, and a manifest.
